suppress.notes: Suppressing unpatchable vulnerabilities in OpenTelemetry alpha dependencies pulled by GCP SDK. These are transient dependencies and the risk is accepted until GCP releases an updated BOM.
Suppressing Tomcat CVEs (CVE-2026-55276, CVE-2026-53434, CVE-2026-53404) for all tomcat-embed modules until Spring Boot updates its managed dependencies to a patched Tomcat version.
Suppressing CVE-2026-0994 for protobuf-java until a stable patch is available.
